notes.title: Announcement Regarding Save Data Loss and Recovery Measures
notes.content:
Hello, this is Guild Studio, the developer of 'Revelatio.'

First, we would like to express our sincerest apologies to all the players who love our game, 'Revelatio.'

During the recent update, an unexpected issue caused the save data of some users to be lost. Although we quickly identified the issue and performed a rollback of the game data, some users' data were not restored. We deeply apologize for the inconvenience caused to the users who lost their data.

If your save file was lost, please contact us at guildstudio2022@gmail.com. We will recreate a save file that reflects your progress as closely as possible and deliver it to you individually. We promise to support you as quickly as possible.

The information needed for data recovery includes:

1. The progress in the Sanctum that you remember
2. Information on your units (unit names, owned Stigmata, and upgrades)
3. Your progress in the acts
4. NPCs you corrupted
5. Player log and current save data

If you provide us with these details, we will recreate and deliver a save file as close as possible to your lost data. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your understanding.

We deeply regret the discomfort this issue has caused during your enjoyment of the game, and we fully take responsibility for the loss of your valuable save files. Once again, we sincerely apologize for the trouble caused.

Should you have any additional inquiries or require assistance with recovery, please feel free to contact us, and we will respond promptly. We are deeply sorry once again and will make every effort to prevent such issues from occurring in the future.

Sincerely,
Guild Studio

notes.title: Hotfix Announcement: About the Game Freezing Bug and Other Fixes for Revelatio
notes.content:
Hello, this is Guild Studio, the developer of Revelatio.

We have identified an issue with a bug affecting game progression after the official release. We have implemented a hotfix, and the details are as follows. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused during gameplay.

* Resolved an issue where the game would not progress after a chapter ended due to a problem with stage save processing.
- If your current chapter is 'chapter 0' or if a black screen (Stage Selection Screen - Endless Notification) appears after completing a chapter, please exit Steam, receive the updated patch, and start a new game by selecting ‘New Game.’
* Fixed an issue where the ESC button would incorrectly close pop-up windows.
* Fixed a bug with the attack mechanism of Appaim
* Fixed an issue where the Apostle of Vice information could not be viewed.
* Fixed a bug where Yohrn would not function properly after corruption.

If chapter-related bugs persist, we kindly ask you to reconnect using the method described above. If any other issues occur that affect your gameplay, please contact us at guildstudio2022@gmail.com, and we will address them as quickly as possible.

Once again, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. Guild Studio will continue to strive to deliver the best possible gaming experience.

notes.title: 'Revelatio' Official Launch Announcement
notes.content:
Wanderers, the time of destiny has finally arrived. The long-awaited 'Revelatio' has at last revealed itself to the world!

Now, you will face the fearful yet formidable elite enemies ‘Libiel’ and ‘Arabella,’ right within the game. Alongside them, the chaos of light and darkness, boss 'Yohrn,' awaits your challenge.

New stigmata have been added to empower your journey, and this update also brings improvements to the UI and UX, further enhancing the immersion of combat and exploration. We sincerely thank all the wanderers who waited for us despite the two-week delay. Now, we hope you fully enjoy your enriched journey into the darkness.

Our story does not end here. 'Revelatio' will continue to grow, and your feedback will serve as a vital compass on this journey. We sincerely hope for your continued anticipation of the updates that are to follow.

Thank you, wanderers. The time has come for you to test your choices and fate.

notes.title: Release Date Delay Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Revelatio Community,

We have some unfortunate news to share regarding the release of Revelatio.

We have been working day and night to deliver the best possible gaming experience to our dedicated community. However, due to unforeseen bugs and the need for additional development time to refine the game, we have made the difficult decision to postpone the release date from September 19th to October 3rd.

Our team has been passionate about bringing you a rich and immersive experience filled with diverse units and a better user interface. However, it has become apparent that we need more time to ensure that Revelatio meets our high standards of quality.

We understand that this delay may be disappointing, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience it may cause. We believe that taking this extra time is crucial to delivering a game that truly lives up to your expectations.

Thank you for your continued support and understanding. We will do our best to make Revelatio the best game it can be.

Sincerely,
Guild Studio

notes.title: 1.0.3v Update Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Feature Update[/h2]

※ In the 1.0.3v update, with the rework of the Sanctum, we will refund the costs associated with previous unlocks.

[olist]
[*] Sanctum rework and new feature additions
- Unlock Reselection I: Gain an opportunity to reset the selection of stigmas upon corrupting an enemy unit once.
- Unlock Reselection II: Gain an opportunity to reset the selection of Baptism, Stigmata, and Sacrifice once.

[*] New Unit Addition: "Messenger"
- The Herald is a unit that performs wide-range attacks at the front. It possesses the unique stigma "Hand of Grace."
 
[*] New Stigmata Addition: "Shadow Cloak", "Grudge", "Solitude", "Hand Of Grace"
- Shadow Cloak: When attacked, there is a 30% chance to invalidates damage.
- Grudge: If ally unit corrupted/edified, Increases attack power by 20
- Solitude: Upon end of this unit's turn when there are no ally unit within adjacent 8 tiles, Gains Attack Boost for 1 times. (Attack Boost: Increases attack power by 50%.)
- Hand Of Grace: Upon attacking, Recovers 30 health to ally units within attack range.

[*] Updates on QoL
- Added battle speed feature: Press the ESC button and enter 'Option' to set the speed between 1x and 2x.
- Added 'Divine Hall sorting' feature and 'Unit Deletion' feature.
- Changed the design and presentation of health bars and faith gems for both allies and enemies.
- Improved visibility of the battle system.
- Added feedback for impossible operations.

[*] Removed the turn-skip function when clicking its own tile.
[/olist]

[h2]Balance Update[/h2]

[olist]
[*] Slaughterer's attack power increased from 8 to 10, cost decreased from 60 to 50.
[/olist]

[h2]Bug Update[/h2]

[olist]
[*] Fixed bugs related to the "Karma" stigma and the "Death Strike."
[/olist]

notes.title: We now reveal the future timeline of Revelatio
notes.content:
Greetings, Wanderers!
We hope the early access of Revelatio has suited the tastes of our dear wanderers!

We are delighted to bring you joyful news once again. At last, it's time to unveil the future timeline of Revelatio!

For those who crave one more step from the early access, the time has finally come to raise the chalice! New stigmata, elite units, and even additional bosses await you in the deeper abyss!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44943740/daa961127ba8b4a2eb3749cacc51d92c5674de52.png[/img]

On June 28th, as a welcoming for the summer, we'll update the game by enhancing UI/UX convenience, adding the powerful new unit 'Messenger', and introducing four new Stigmata.

On July 20th, we plan to unveil the new elite unit 'Angel' through our community. Witness the astounding power of the Angel!

On August 10th, we plan to unveil the new elite unit 'Oblivion' through our community. Don't be swayed by her beauty

On September 1st, we plan to unveil the new boss 'Yohrn' through our community. Will the birth of new life possess the power to hinder the ever-spreading darkness?

Finally, on September 19th comes the official release! It is time to encounter the last chapter of your darkest journey. Also, the three units revealed on our community will come to life in the game along with 9 new stigmata.

It's time to enter the shadows of darkness and build your dominion!

Become one with the darkness 💀
